verdict.rationale: Figma Make's docs say teams can collaborate in the same conversations, leave comments, and modify the generated code at the same time within a shared Make file. Multiple chats can also run in a single file, which supports parallel teamwork. Missing for 10: detail on team-level shared workspace or permission management beyond file sharing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time co-editing.

support.subject: As a founder, my team can work on the same project together in a shared workspace

citations.quote: Collaborate with your team](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/38701587731735) in the same conversations, leave comments, and simultaneously modify the generated code
Share that file with others to use while setting guidelines for how the styles and functionality can be changed
You can run more than one chat at the same time in a single Make file, so you can start a new change while another chat is still working.
